# Tool inventory

**When to read this.** You need a tool and do not know its name; OR you are unsure whether a tool exists on this server; OR you want the one rule that matters most for a tool before you call it.

Every tool the server registers with the real adapter: **128 tools in 24 namespaces**, generated from the registry of the server this skill ships beside. Verified 2026-09-19 against voltras-mcp main (#479, store schema 35). The generated reference on the docs site carries the full descriptions. If a name here is missing from the harness, the live server is older than this skill; see the preflight in `14-sittings.md`. `mock.*` (2 tools) exists only under the mock adapter and is not listed.

Names use dots here (`plan.block.schedule`). The harness shows underscores (`plan_block_schedule`).

Key: **W** writes to the store or the device. **R** reads only. **D** is a diagnostic; never relay its output as a recommendation.

## 1. Find and connect the device

| Tool                      |     | When                                                        | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------- | --- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `device.scan`             | W   | Start of every workout                                      | `device.connect` reads only the MOST RECENT scan. `DEVICE_NOT_FOUND` on connect means scan again                                                                                                       |
| `device.set_passive_scan` | W   | You want a `voltras_available` event when a unit appears    | Off at server start. It pauses while any slot is connected                                                                                                                                             |
| `device.connect`          | W   | After scan, once per unit                                   | A first pairing asks the lifter to accept on the device; allow 30 s. `CONNECTION_REFUSED` is never retried for you. `stateConfirmed: false` means setters refuse until the device reports its settings |
| `device.disconnect`       | W   | End of workout                                              | It does NOT close an open set or session. Call `set.end` and `session.end` first                                                                                                                       |
| `device.get_state`        | R   | After EVERY setter and every cascade                        | Setters resolve on write, not on agreement. This is the only proof a request landed. Fields are flat                                                                                                   |
| `slot.bindings_list`      | R   | Before a bilateral connect                                  | Tells you whether the side-ID ritual can be skipped                                                                                                                                                    |
| `slot.identify`           | W   | First bilateral session                                     | The named unit's screen changes for 3 s. The lifter says which side it was                                                                                                                             |
| `slot.bind`               | W   | After the lifter confirms a side                            | Write once. Later `device.connect {slot: 'auto'}` routes by it                                                                                                                                         |
| `slot.unbind`             | W   | A unit moved sides for good                                 | The next auto connect falls back to the ritual                                                                                                                                                         |
| `slot.swap`               | W   | Two units are bound the wrong way round                     | Memory only, no device traffic. Needs exactly two connected slots                                                                                                                                      |
| `system.lease_acquire`    | W   | Before driving hardware when another client may be attached | `force: true` unloads the other holder's device. Use it only when the user confirms that session is abandoned. Never pass `acceptLoadedDevice` unless the device is confirmed unattended               |
| `system.lease_status`     | R   | A contended device                                          | `generation` rises each time the lease changes hands                                                                                                                                                   |
| `system.lease_release`    | W   | End of workout                                              | Unloads first if anything is still engaged                                                                                                                                                             |
| `server.health`           | R   | Once after connect, and at the top of every sitting         | `build` may read "unknown". Read `adapter`, `dbPath`, `dashboardAvailable`, `dashboardUrl`, `cues`, `cuesMidSet`, `autoArm`, `voiceReady`. Give `dashboardUrl` to the user exactly as reported         |

## 2. Load the cable

| Tool                                        |     | When                                                   | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `bilateral.cascade`                         | W   | Weight Training, one or both units                     | All four are required: `mode`, `weightLbs`, `eccentricOverloadLbs`, `chainsLbs`. Read `results[i].modeEcho`; on `timeout` that slot failed and its other setters never went out. Do not send a non-WeightTraining mode through it (VW-162, open) |
| `device.set_mode`                           | W   | Every non-WeightTraining mode, per slot, FIRST         | Then compare `requested_mode` with `active_mode` in `get_state` before anything else. `Idle` is not selectable                                                                                                                                   |
| `device.set_weight`                         | W   | One unit, weight only                                  | 5 to 200 lb, whole pounds. Set it BEFORE `set.start`. Under tension it does not apply to the set in progress; read `weightChangeWarning` out                                                                                                     |
| `device.set_chains`                         | W   | Chains on one unit                                     | 0 to 100 lb, capped at the base weight by the device. Never tell the user which end of the rep is heavier; that is an open question                                                                                                              |
| `device.set_eccentric`                      | W   | Eccentric overload on one unit                         | **Pounds, never a percent**: -195 to +195. `percent` is a deprecated alias with the same meaning. Read `mountLoadWarning` out. It is a cost knob, not a growth multiplier                                                                        |
| `device.set_damper_level`                   | W   | Damper mode                                            | 0 to 9. The device screen shows the value plus one                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `device.set_assist_mode`                    | W   | Assist on or off                                       | It lives in the device's Settings menu, not the idle screen                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `device.set_band_max_force`                 | W   | Resistance Band mode                                   | 15 to 70 lb                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `device.configure_isokinetic`               | W   | Isokinetic mode, after `set_mode`                      | One call for all isokinetic fields. Speeds are mm/s; the screen shows m/s. Setting an eccentric weight makes the unit beep; the write still succeeds                                                                                             |
| `device.set_isokinetic_target_speed`        | W   | Deprecated                                             | Use `device.configure_isokinetic`                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `device.set_isokinetic_ecc_mode`            | W   | Deprecated                                             | Use `device.configure_isokinetic`                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `device.set_isokinetic_ecc_speed_limit`     | W   | Deprecated                                             | Use `device.configure_isokinetic`                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `device.set_isokinetic_ecc_const_weight`    | W   | Deprecated                                             | Use `device.configure_isokinetic`                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `device.set_isokinetic_ecc_overload_weight` | W   | Deprecated                                             | Use `device.configure_isokinetic`                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `device.enter_row_mode`                     | W   | Rowing, stage 1 of 2                                   | The cable does not engage until `device.start_row`                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `device.start_row`                          | W   | Rowing, stage 2 of 2                                   | Distance presets only pick a screen on the unit                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `device.unload`                             | W   | Stop the load; recover from anything uncertain         | Read `read_back.verdict`. `unconfirmed` means the cable is unverified: call again and confirm by eye. `load_state: unloaded` also appears during ordinary reps, so it proves nothing                                                             |
| `device.start_guided_load`                  | W   | Starting from a contracted position only. Experimental | It is a ceremony, not "load the cable". Weight Training only. It creates its own set, so pass `isWarmup` and `watch` here or a ramp counts as working sets. `armed` confirms nothing                                                             |
| `device.exit_guided_load`                   | W   | Leave a guided-load flow. Experimental                 | Its read-back is always `unconfirmed`. `device.unload` is the release the device confirms                                                                                                                                                        |

## 3. Record the work

| Tool                   |     | When                                                                                              | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `exercise.search`      | R   | Before every `session.start` and exercise change                                                  | Use the returned `id`. Name matching elsewhere is exact                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `exercise.get`         | R   | You hold an id and need the entry                                                                 | `NOT_FOUND` means search first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `session.start`        | W   | Before the lifter touches the handle, per slot                                                    | Pass `exerciseId`. An auto-armed set copies the session's exercise at that instant and is never relabelled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `session.set_exercise` | W   | Before EVERY exercise change                                                                      | Same reason. Unlabelled sets are invisible to goals, baselines and progression                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `session.set_lifter`   | W   | A guest steps in, and again when the owner is back                                                | `{lifter: 'Jordan'}` then `{lifter: null}`. It affects sets started after the call                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `set.start`            | W   | After the weight is verified, before "go"                                                         | Pass `setPurpose`. On `set_started {auto_armed: true}` call it at once to upgrade that set in place; it works once per set. A velocity-loss watch needs a `pct`, an `intent`, or a planned `trainingIntent`, else the call is refused                                                                                                                                                              |
| `set.live_metrics`     | R   | Push is not working and you must poll                                                             | `{active: false}` means no active set. Prefer `watch`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `set.end`              | W   | The lifter released and no `set_ended` came                                                       | It is what persists reps. Never skip it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `set.get`              | R   | Inspect one stored set                                                                            | If rep counts disagree it reports the split. Do not pick a winner                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `set.update`           | W   | A set ran under the wrong lifter label                                                            | Only the label is editable. It re-derives the owner's baseline                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `session.checkin`      | W   | After the very first session, then at the end of each completed training week                     | Show their own numbers first. Never a gate. A guest session writes nothing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `session.end`          | W   | End of workout, per slot                                                                          | Always. A session never ended is not a training day today (VW-489). Takes an optional `checkin`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `session.list`         | R   | Browse history                                                                                    | Keep `detail: summary`. A full session can be over 100 KB                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `session.get`          | R   | One session in full                                                                               | Carries `sessionPace` when a plan is attached: an estimate, never a measurement                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `session.review_list`  | R   | Before any read of history: goals, the tier signal, attendance, the weekly review, block planning | Defaults to the days nobody has classified, and an unclassified day is left out of every history read — so an empty history may mean "not yet reviewed" rather than "not yet trained". Feed a row's `day` straight to `session.mark_kind`                                                                                                                                                          |
| `session.mark_kind`    | W   | The lifter has told you what a day was                                                            | **Never guess a kind. Ask.** `dryRun: true` first; a real `from`/`to` call then needs `expectSessions` equal to the count the dry run reported. A day or range call leaves a session already marked the other kind alone unless `reclassify: true`; naming a `sessionId` may always reclassify. Read `rederiveFailed` out and re-run `baselines.recalc` and `rir_velocity.fit` for those exercises |

## 4. Rest, voice and cues

| Tool                  |     | When                                        | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `timer.start`         | W   | Every rest. The default                     | Non-blocking. Omit `durationMs` to take the plan's `restSec`, else a default by training goal. Read `restBasis` for why                                                                              |
| `timer.wait`          | W   | Short quiet rests, or push never registered | It blocks. Only one at a time; a second returns `BUSY`                                                                                                                                               |
| `timer.cancel`        | W   | Cut a rest short                            | Safe to call when nothing is running                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `system.speak`        | W   | A short spoken cue                          | **The mic is deaf while any line plays**, safety phrases included (VW-173, open). Keep it short. Never speak while waiting on a spoken reply, or over a heavy set. `interrupt: true` drops the queue |
| `system.set_cues`     | W   | Turn automatic spoken cues on or off        | Both default off. Leave `midSet` off                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `system.listen_start` | W   | The lifter wants voice control              | Safety phrases unload EVERY connected slot with no model turn. A `voice_command_applied` event means the write already happened                                                                      |
| `system.listen_stop`  | W   | Voice no longer wanted                      | Call it yourself. A spoken request over a cue never arrives                                                                                                                                          |

## 5. Plan: read what is in force

| Tool                              |     | When                                               | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------- | --- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `plan.current_block`              | R   | Top of every sitting; any "where am I in the plan" | `state` is `current`, `upcoming`, `gap` or `undated_only`. When `planning.due`, ask about planning and create nothing until they answer. Its existence is also the is-this-main test                                                        |
| `plan.next_workout`               | R   | "What do I do today?"                              | Three shapes: a template, `{completed: true}`, or `{unplanned: true}`. On unplanned, say training continues unplanned and never present a workout from the ended block. Relay `blockBoundary.realignment` and `recompReAsk`; neither writes |
| `plan.block.planning_brief`       | R   | The planning sitting, after the lifter says yes    | Reads only. `finishing` and `realignment` are null when no block has dates. `dietPhase: null` means none is declared; raise it                                                                                                              |
| `plan.block.calendar`             | R   | Read back a block's dates                          | A week with `templateCount: 0` has nothing planned. `history.fact` is one sentence you can say                                                                                                                                              |
| `plan.block.schedule_history`     | R   | "How has this block moved?"                        | Oldest first, with who made each change                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `plan.program.list`               | R   | Find a program                                     | Pass `includeArchived` only when asked                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `plan.program.get`                | R   | One program by id                                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `plan.block.list_for_program`     | R   | Walk the tree down                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `plan.week.list_for_block`        | R   | Walk the tree down                                 | Each week reports `isDeload` and `phaseType`                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `plan.template.list_for_week`     | R   | Walk the tree down                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `plan.template.get`               | R   | One template by id                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `plan.exercise.list_for_template` | R   | The prescribed exercises of one workout            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

## 6. Plan: write

| Tool                     |     | When                                                    | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------ | --- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `plan.block.schedule`    | W   | Date, move or un-date a block that has not started      | `startsOn` is a local Monday. A started or ended block never moves. Overlap and out-of-order dates are refused and the error names the other block. Read `targetsAffected` back |
| `plan.block.create`      | W   | A new block, planned ahead                              | Takes `startsOn`, `scaffoldWeeks`, `deloadWeeks`. For an existing dated block use `schedule` or `update` instead                                                                |
| `plan.block.update`      | W   | Rename or resize a block                                | The start never moves here. Refused on an ended block and when a resize would overlap                                                                                           |
| `plan.week.skip`         | W   | A missed week in the CURRENT block                      | **Ask hold or extend, every time.** Pass the answer as `mode`. Omit `mode` only when they did not choose. Read `weekOf` back                                                    |
| `plan.week.update`       | W   | Flag a deload, rename a week                            | Dates come from the block, never the week                                                                                                                                       |
| `plan.week.create`       | W   | Build a week under a block                              |                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `plan.template.create`   | W   | Build a workout under a week                            |                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `plan.exercise.create`   | W   | Add a prescribed exercise                               | `warnings[]` are suggestions. The write always succeeds. Read a warning out, offer its fix, drop it after a decline                                                             |
| `plan.program.create`    | W   | A new program                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `plan.program.archive`   | W   | Retire a program                                        | Archived programs never count as the plan in force                                                                                                                              |
| `plan.attach_to_session` | W   | Link a live session to its template or planned exercise | Exactly one of the two ids                                                                                                                                                      |
| `plan.complete_workout`  | W   | End of a planned workout                                | Pass `sessionId` explicitly. Returns `current`, and `blockBoundary` on the last workout of a block                                                                              |
| `truecoach.import_week`  | W   | The owner asks to pull their coach-assigned week        | A by-hand read of the user's own data. Never present it as a sanctioned integration. `dryRun: true` first                                                                       |

## 7. Plan: suggestions (relay, never apply)

| Tool                                |     | When                                   | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------------- | --- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `plan.suggest_progression`          | R   | "What next time?"                      | An estimated 1RM never moves load. An asymmetry never prescribes single-limb work. When the diet phase changed the answer, relay that clause, not the bare delta |
| `plan.warmup_ramp`                  | R   | Before the first working set of a lift | A population estimate, not personal. Start each rung yourself as `warmup`. Run the last rung                                                                     |
| `progression.get_for_exercise`      | R   | "What did I hit last time?"            | If `comparability` says `noValidComparison`, say what changed. On `setup_confounded`, do not read a left/right gap as an imbalance                               |
| `profile.get_starting_prescription` | R   | A new lifter or a new exercise         | Seeds are low on purpose. Do not round up. `assumesBeginner: true` means say so                                                                                  |

## 8. Goals

| Tool                                |     | When                                                                            | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `goal.declare_priorities`           | W   | The lifter says what matters                                                    | **Takes no target value.** Date the block first; read `block` back. Guardrails are advisory. Relay the fat-loss downgrade offer; never apply it                       |
| `goal.propose_targets`              | W   | Once per priority                                                               | Every input is read, none is typed. Read out both edges, `infoLevel`, `tierProvisional`, notes and every `skipped[]` reason. Raise a `recalibrationOffers` entry once |
| `goal.accept_target`                | W   | On the lifter's word, one target at a time                                      | After this the numbers never move. Their own number past the stretch edge needs `acknowledgeStretch: true`. `anchorLoad` only for `reps_at_load`                      |
| `goal.list`                         | R   | Read the accepted set back                                                      | A target with no `acceptedBy` is an unanswered proposal                                                                                                               |
| `goal.retire`                       | W   | A goal ended, or a proposal is declined                                         | Ask for the outcome: `met`, `missed`, `abandoned`. A retired proposal is never re-offered, so do not retire one the lifter only wants to postpone                     |
| `goal.new_chapter`                  | W   | The lifter says the movement itself changed                                     | Never infer it from a drop. The numbers do not move                                                                                                                   |
| `goal.weekly_review`                | W   | The Sunday bodyweight-rate review                                               | Never sized: it names intake and activity and the pick is the lifter's. Name any veto. Answer a `proposal` with `response`                                            |
| `accountability.declare_commitment` | W   | The lifter states or corrects which days they will train, at the Sunday sitting | Their words are stored verbatim. Never rewrite them, and never set the session count here                                                                             |

## 9. Profile, bodyweight, diet phase, check-ins

| Tool                              |     | When                                | The rule that matters                                                                                                                |
| --------------------------------- | --- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `profile.get_onboarding_gaps`     | R   | Start of a workout or sitting       | Ask the first `missing[]` item, not a list of your own. Ask `lastBreakQuestion` as written. A cardiovascular flag goes to a doctor   |
| `profile.set_training_background` | W   | Each onboarding answer              | A merge, except `injuries`, which replaces the list; `[]` means "asked, none". Store their words; never infer a tier                 |
| `profile.get_training_background` | R   | Read the stored answers             | `profile: null` means nothing captured                                                                                               |
| `profile.get_tier_signal`         | R   | Before any tier-gated decision      | A crude ceiling, not a classification. Say `confidence` and `ceilingBasis`. Logged days include bench tests today                    |
| `profile.log_bodyweight`          | W   | The lifter gives a weight           | **Copy the health log's value and its time.** Never a second independent reading. Never ask for leanness fields or for a measurement |
| `profile.get_body_metrics`        | R   | Read weigh-ins back                 | The 7-day mean needs 3 readings in 7 days. A body-fat number is display only. A change inside its band is "no measurable change"     |
| `profile.set_diet_phase`          | W   | The lifter names their actual phase | The only writer of the phase. A recomposition REQUIRES `recompMode`, asked, never inferred. Read the timeline back                   |
| `profile.log_weekly_checkin`      | W   | Sunday                              | Three optional ratings. Call it even when all are skipped. Sleep is a confounder line only                                           |
| `profile.get_weekly_checkin`      | R   | Read a week's check-in              | `checkin: null` differs from a check-in with blank fields                                                                            |
| `profile.respond_recomp_advisory` | W   | A `recompReAsk.proposal` is open    | Neither answer changes the phase. Call it only when a proposal is actually open                                                      |

## 10. Read the work back

| Tool                     |     | When                                                | The rule that matters                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------ | --- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `metrics.compute`        | R   | After a set or session                              | 18 pipelines by `pipeline`. Readouts, never recommendations. `vbt.rir` names its `basis`; a `profile-estimate` is not a proximity-to-failure read. `fatigue.verdict` matches the wall. `history.trend` is where an e1RM belongs |
| `report.session_results` | R   | After `session.end`                                 | Working sets only. The session must be ended                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `report.weekly`          | R   | The Sunday review                                   | Counts training days, never a streak. Progression lines are "suggestion for the coach, not applied"                                                                                                                             |
| `rir_velocity.fit`       | W   | After new failure sets on a lift                    | Needs 3 qualifying sets over 2 sessions at 70 to 90% of the estimate. A failed fit DELETES the stored curve. Read `reason` out                                                                                                  |
| `rir_velocity.target`    | R   | Turn a reps-in-reserve prescription into a velocity | Null with no curve; no group curve is substituted. `withinFittedRange: false` is an extrapolation                                                                                                                               |
| `coaching.explain`       | R   | You need the sourced reason behind a rule           | Never strip the tier. Quote a `caveats` topic as a range                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `accountability.state`   | R   | "What would the coach message do now?"              | Reads only. Sends nothing                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `accountability.preview` | R   | End of the Sunday sitting, optional                 | Renders the message from live reads. Sends nothing                                                                                                                                                                              |

## 11. Isometric assessments

Do not plan any of these while the mount rating is unknown (VW-274, open). Isometric mode can pull up to 400 lb per unit whatever weight is set. If the lifter asks for one, read `mountLoadWarning` out first.

| Tool                          |     | When                                  | The rule that matters                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `isometric.measure_hold`      | W   | One coach-paced hold                  | You set Isometric mode and a low resistance first. Peak force is the headline                                              |
| `isometric.measure_max`       | W   | The full 3-trial protocol on one unit | Runs its own warm-up pulls and 120 s rests. The inferred working weight is a heuristic, never a 1RM                        |
| `isometric.measure_imbalance` | W   | Both sides                            | No fixed threshold. A difference is real only past the lifter's own trial spread. Never prescribe single-limb work from it |

## 12. Setups and chapters

| Tool                        |     | When                                      | The rule that matters                                                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | --- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baselines.get`             | D   | "How much do we know about this lift?"    | A confidence state, not a value. Below CALIBRATED, treat derived numbers as provisional. Say `pooledFallback` when true   |
| `baselines.recalc`          | W D | Old history, or a forced re-derive        | `reharvest` labels failures that already happened. Never praise one or ask for more. `inferSetups` returns neutral labels |
| `exercise.confirm_setup`    | W   | The lifter names a setup                  | The label and the card are THEIR answer. Never offer a guess to confirm                                                   |
| `exercise.mark_new_chapter` | W   | The lifter says the movement changed      | Manual only. Never because a number dropped                                                                               |
| `exercise.retire_chapter`   | W   | Undo a chapter                            | By the `chapterId` the declaration returned                                                                               |
| `driftguard.check`          | D   | A human asks why a comparison was refused | Not a step in a coaching decision                                                                                         |
| `mrvguard.check`            | D   | A human asks about a deload signal        | Needs three session ids, oldest first                                                                                     |

## 13. Debug (on an explicit request only)

| Tool                        |     | When                                                          | The rule that matters                                                                   |
| --------------------------- | --- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `debug.recent_events`       | D   | "What just happened?"                                         | Your first debug read                                                                   |
| `debug.recording_status`    | D   | Is the flight recorder on                                     |                                                                                         |
| `debug.push_test_channel`   | W D | Does push reach this session                                  | A missing event means the launch flag did not register; fall back to polling            |
| `debug.confirm_channel`     | W D | Confirm the test event arrived                                |                                                                                         |
| `debug.compare_rep_streams` | D   | Rep counts disagree                                           | Report the split. The device counts reps                                                |
| `debug.recent_frames`       | D   | Only when the user asks for low-level capture                 | **Never quote its content** in chat, notes, tasks or commits                            |
| `device.send_raw`           | W   | Only on the user's explicit request, in a validation campaign | Needs `confirm: true`. It can move the motor. **Never quote what was sent or received** |

## Resources and push events

Three `voltra://` resources and the push events are listed in `08-channel-events-reference.md`. Push arrives only when Claude Code was launched with `--channels plugin:voltras-channel@voltras-local`. Any other launch degrades to polling with no error.
